feeds.title: Changemakers
feeds.description: Changemakers is an online publication providing a platform for the people and ideas positively transforming the world. Ashoka has a radical vision for an 'Everyone a Changemaker' world, where all are empowered to make a positive impact, big or small, in their community.

feeds.title: Inspiring Women Changemakers Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring Women Changemakers is an inclusive community of people who stand for fairness & safety for women at work, at home & in society.

feeds.title: Impact Boom Blog
feeds.description: Impact Boom is the place where great leaders, changemakers & social innovators share the latest ideas, initiatives, insights & inspiration to help you create positive social impact.

feeds.title: Changemaker Toolkit Blog
feeds.description: Ideas and inspiration to help you become a changemaker. Alex Budak created and teaches the transformational course 'Becoming a Changemaker'. He is a social entrepreneur and professional faculty member at UC Berkeley.

feeds.title: All Tech Is Human Blog
feeds.description: Covers all news, stories, research regarding the Responsible Tech movement & community. All Tech Is Human is an accelerator for tech consideration and hub for the Responsible Tech community.

feeds.title: Changemaker Blog | Fordham Social Innovation Collaboratory
feeds.description: Changemaker Stories to see some of the social innovators whose work has made Fordham an Ashoka Changemaker campus. Changemaker aim's to be inclusive and to draw content from a myriad of sources, including our University newsroom, our SI Collaboratory partners, and the vast resources of the web. Curated by Ron Jacobson, who serves on the Social Innovation Collaboratory Steering Committee.

feeds.title: LifeBeyondNumbers » Changemakers
feeds.description: Read some of the most inspiring stories of Changemakers working towards an inclusive society, for good. Celebrating the unsung heroes from your nearby areas. Life Beyond Number's purpose is to stimulate a positive change through the stories created and curated.

feeds.title: The Rural Changemakers Blog
feeds.description: The Rural Changemaker blog is a vehicle for social change, gender equality, and education. The story of Janwaar Castle only started in April 2015 and it has inspired many people in India and abroad to think about skateboarding as a tool for change.

feeds.title: Well+Good » Changemakers
feeds.description: Stories from the wellness innovators seeking to change the way we all (not just a select few) eat, move, think, and care for ourselves and each other. Well+Good is the leading source of intel on boutique fitness and the juice industry, plus cutting-edge nutrition and natural beauty.
